subject.title: fix(qqbot): allow approval buttons in direct C2C conversations

question: Which QQBot identity must a direct C2C approval callback match before it may resolve a privileged approval?
rationale: Current main requires explicit actor authorization, while this PR treats every direct sender as trusted; repository evidence does not establish whether pairing state, the approval recipient, a configured approver, or a platform guarantee is the intended authority.

options.title: Bind to approval recipient
options.body: Record or carry the intended C2C recipient and require the callback sender and conversation to match it before resolving the approval.

options.title: Require configured authority
options.body: Keep direct and group callbacks behind the existing command or `execApprovals` authorization and improve configuration or recovery guidance.

options.title: Trust all C2C callbacks
options.body: Accept the bypass only after official QQ contract evidence and live adversarial proof establish that another admitted DM sender cannot invoke or replay the callback.

recommendation.title: Bind to approval recipient
recommendation.body: Record or carry the intended C2C recipient and require the callback sender and conversation to match it before resolving the approval.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged and recently maintained the authorization contract this PR changes.
